name: powerops
description: Plan, review and gate Microsoft Power Platform builds: powerops-plan turns an idea into a signed-off plan, powerops-review-plan reviews it in a fresh context, and powerops-implement builds only from a signed-off plan, handing the build to Microsoft's skills. It also starts the PowerOps MCP server (`powerops mcp`), whose tools check, diff, test and plan a deploy, and import only after the user types the target's name. Needs the `powerops` CLI on PATH: see Install in the PowerOps README.
